localContent:
Extreme close crop of existing south CITY WALL, NOT plaza floor or whole building. Same native-scale pale natural grey/beige limestone, rounded hand-painted bevels, restrained mineral variation matching actual anchors. No gritty noise, no photoreal plastic, no standalone props/trees/pots/buildings/text/UI. Native anchors override coarse guide joint positions: true mortar continues across x115/y115 and x230/y230 until actual stone-course boundaries. Anchor edge is never an object edge, no short isolated joint, no straight texture/value stripe. Broad pale flat masonry only. Inherit west's upper thin horizontal course around y145 and lower course around y963, rather than coarse guide y780. Sparse staggered vertical joints must connect full actual courses. No railing or foundation at this row.
CRITICAL SINGLE FLAT WALL PLANE: The ONLY horizontal mortar positions in this crop are y145 and y963. At y230 where the top native strip ends there is NO joint: continue exactly the same large stone surface all the way to y963. At x115 where the left native strip ends there is NO vertical joint: continue that same surface rightward to its full-width stone block. No vertical frame on x115 or x230. The guide's coarse y780 band is a low-resolution hint and MUST NOT determine a new joint. Follow actual left y963, NOT y780/y810. Preserve native top strip y0..230 and left x0..115 but let all surfaces cross their invisible limits without any line or color stripe. If using a staggered vertical joint, place it around x600 spanning only between actual y145 and y963. Lower course y963..1254 continues open. Do not create large rectangular framed panels or raised tiling.
